thesis: Transmute Artifact turned an expendable artifact into the exact machine a deck needed, previewing the dangerous tutor-and-cheat design space later occupied by Tinker.

canonicalIdentity.originalPrintedText: Sacrifice an artifact. If you do, search your library for an artifact card. If that card's mana value is less than or equal to the sacrificed artifact's mana value, put it onto the battlefield. If it's greater, you may pay {X}, where X is the difference. If you do, put it onto the battlefield. If you don't, put it into its owner's graveyard. Then shuffle.

competitiveTimeline.significance: The card powered early artifact combo and control engines and remains one of Antiquities’ clearest demonstrations that tutoring directly onto the battlefield can collapse normal mana costs.
